localizedValues.name: S1-Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
Picnic shelter- enclosed shelter has tables, sinks and BBQ.Alcohol permitted at tables only. No keg beer permitted. No amplified music. Group must clean shelter when done. Group event must end at dusk. Users must vacate by dark. Horseshoes available for check out at office.Tennis, basketball and volleyball courts nearby.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
No amplified music without prior permission from park staff. If approved, music allowed 10 AM-1 PM and 7 PM-9 PM. Lawns irrigated in zones. No tent set up until assigned by a ranger. Restroom and grounds cleanliness is group's responsibility. Group will be charged an additional fee if trash exceeds the 3 dumpsters provided. Groups encouraged to limit trash and recycle. Weekly maintenance closures every Tuesday and Wednesday.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
